title: osEngineer repository profile (.osengineer/profile.json)
description: The single per-repository configuration read by the hooks, the osengineer CLI and the task runtime through repo_profile/config.py, which enforces these rules. A missing file means every default below. Any invalid value fails closed: hooks block (exit 2), the runtime returns needs-human, the CLI exits non-zero. Every key is optional.

relPath.description: Repository-relative POSIX path; no absolute paths, no .. segments. A trailing / is stripped.

protocol.description: codex-exec: `<runner> exec --json --output-schema ...`; env: the OSE_PROFILE_* environment protocol.

profile.description: "repo" switches the hooks into repo-profile mode (also reachable via workbench-config.yml validation_profile: repo).

planDirectory.description: Repo-profile plan namespace; runtime evidence lives under <planDirectory>/osengineer/.

context.description: Context-window thresholds in percent REMAINING, shared by post-tool and prompt-guard. criticalPct must not exceed warnPct.

reinjectPct.description: Generic-mode prompt-guard re-injects the phase plan and worker constraints at or below this.

routing.description: Repo-profile prompt routing from the skill registry.

excludeNamePattern.description: Case-insensitive regex; matching skill names are never routed. Empty string excludes nothing.

projection.description: Registry projection key preferred over the canonical path; null uses canonical only.

configDirs.description: Top-level directories whose .yml/.yaml/.json files stay editable during discuss/plan under validation_profile: infra.

policy.description: Evaluation policy (eval-policy.schema.json) whose presence is the eval-policy fact.

runners.description: Runner executable basename -> protocol. Replaces the default map when present.

handlers.description: Detected fact -> handler. Written only by `osengineer profile detect --write` or by hand; a fact with no entry is reported by `osengineer profile doctor`, never auto-enabled. {"enabled": false} acknowledges a fact without handling it.
